# 1 - Set paths and root directory, load packages

```{r, setup, include=FALSE}

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  tidycensus,
  mapcdatakeys,
  janitor,
  readxl,
  rjson,
  stringr,
  data.table,
  here
)

# Set ACS / PUMS vintage
vintage <-  2023

# Set MAPC at 101 or 97 towns
# reb <- 'MAPC101'
reb <- 'MAPC97'

if (grepl('VM',Sys.info()[['nodename']])){
  base <- '//data-sync/Public/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/'
} else {
  base <- 'S:/Network Shares/K Drive/DataServices/Projects/Current_Projects/'
}

root <- paste0(base,'Projections/Projections_2028/Data/01_Regional_Control_Totals/')

rwt.path <- paste0(root, 'Reweighter/LRTP_2028/')
mapcm.path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'MAPCM/')
swm.path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'SWM/')

shop.path <- paste0(root, 'SHoP_Scenarios/Reweighter_Outputs/Scenario_3/')

mpos <- mapcdatakeys::all_muni_data_keys |> pull(mpo) |> unique()

if (reb == 'MAPC97') {
  input_path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'SWM/Input_Files/')
  output_path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'SWM/Output_Files/')
  dir.create(input_path, showWarnings = F)
  dir.create(output_path, showWarnings = F)
  for (m in mpos) {
    dir.create(paste0(input_path, m), showWarnings = F)
    dir.create(paste0(output_path, m), showWarnings = F)
  }
}

if (reb == 'MAPC101') {
  input_path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'MAPCM/Input_Files/')
  output_path <- paste0(rwt.path, 'MAPCM/Output_Files/')
  dir.create(input_path, showWarnings = F)
  dir.create(output_path, showWarnings = F)
  dir.create(paste0(input_path, 'MAPC'), showWarnings = F)
}

# Set Shelter Households path
shelter.path <- paste0(
  base,
  'Housing/StatewideHousingPlan/04_Analysis/Data/Final_Outputs/Shelter_Households/'
)

## turn off scientific notation
options(scipen = 999)
#Set random seed
set.seed(351)
# Helper function
sun <- function(x){sort(unique(x))}
lun <- function(x){length(unique(x))}

#Set knitr path
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rwt.path)

```

# 3 - Create RPA config JSON files for reweighter configuration

```{r}

# Template config file
infile1 <- paste0(rwt.path, 'Templates/reweighting_config_2023.json')

for (m in mpos){
  outfile1 <- paste0(input_path, m, '/reweighting_config_2023_', m, '.json')
  cfig1 = readLines(infile1)
  cfig1 = gsub('PUMS2023', paste0('PUMS2023_', m), cfig1)
  writeLines(cfig1, outfile1)
}

```

# 4 - Configure, set targets and run reweighter for each RPA and year


```{r}


source(here('scripts/reweighter/algo_hh.R'))


# for (yr in c(2040,2045,2050)) {
  for (yr in c(2035, 2040, 2045, 2050)) {
  for (mid in c('MAPC','OCPC')) {
    # for (mid in mpos) {
    # Set config
    inpath <- paste0(input_path, mid, '/')
    source(here('scripts/reweighter/read_config_RPA.R'))
    message(paste0(mid, ' configuration complete'))
    
    # Set targets
    outpath <- paste0(output_path, mid, '/')
    dir.create(outpath, showWarnings = F)
    template <- fread(paste0(rwt.path, 'Templates/AgeHHder_HHtype_template.csv')) |>
      select(-BASELINE, -TARGET)
    target <- fread(paste0(input_path, 'hhtype.targetfile.', reb, '.y', yr, '.csv')) |>
      filter(RPA == mid) |>
      select(-RPA) |>
      right_join(template, by = c('AgeCat', 'HHtype')) |>
      setDT()
    
    target[AgeCat %in% c('x == 1', 'x == 2', 'x == 3'), `:=`(BASELINE =
                                                               0,
                                                             INTER = 0,
                                                             TARGET = 0)]
    target[is.na(BASELINE), `:=`(BASELINE = 0,
                                 INTER = 0,
                                 TARGET = 0)]
    setorder(target, AgeCat, HHtype)
    fwrite(target, paste0(inpath, '/AgeHHder_HHtype.csv'))
    
    # Tenure target file
    template2 <- fread(paste0(rwt.path, 'Templates/age_tenure_template.csv'))
    target2 <- fread(paste0(input_path, 'tenure.targetfile.', reb, '.y', yr, '.csv')) |>
      filter(RPA == mid) |>
      select(-RPA) |>
      right_join(template2, by = c('AgeCat', 'tenure')) |>
      setDT()
    
    target2[is.na(BASELINE), `:=`(BASELINE = 0,
                                  INTER = 0,
                                  TARGET = 0)]
    setorder(target2, AgeCat, tenure)
    fwrite(target2, paste0(inpath, '/age_tenure.csv'))
    
    message(paste0(mid, ' targets set'))
    
    pums <- fread(paste0(input_path, mid, '/PUMS', vintage, '_', mid,'.csv'))
    
    source(here('scripts/reweighter/Manage_Scenario_RPA.R'))
    message(paste0(mid, ' reweighter complete'))
    
    mess <- data.table(txt = paste0(mid, ' reweighter complete'))
    fwrite(mess, paste0(outpath, mid, '_', yr, '_complete.txt'))
  }
}


```


# 5 - Check that all years/RPAs successfully converged

```{r}
  
log.comp <- c()
for (mid in mpos) {
  outpath <- paste0(output_path, mid, '/')
  logs <- list.files(path = outpath, pattern =paste0('logfile_',reb))
  for (f in logs){
    df <- readLines(paste0(outpath,f))
    log.comp <- c(log.comp, if (length(
      grep("Maximum deviation from target stopping condition achieved", df)
    ) != 0) {
      print(paste0(f, ' success'))
    } else if (length(grep("Maximum number of iterations reached", df)) !=
               0) {
      print(paste0(f, ' failed to converge'))
    } else if (length(grep(
      "No change in weights stopping condition met", df
    )) != 0) {
      print(paste0(f, ' no change in weights'))
    })
  }
}
fwrite(as.data.table(log.comp),paste0(output_path,'/reweighter_convergence_check_',reb,'.txt'))




```

# 6 - Create reweighted PUMS files

```{r}
c0 <- data.table()
comp.dt <- data.table()

if(reb=='MAPC97') {

for (yr in c(2025, 2030,2035,2040,2045,2050)){
  for (mid in mpos) {
    inpath <- paste0(input_path, mid, '/')
    outpath <- paste0(output_path, mid, '/')
    
    # Calculate total households from the reweighter outputs
   
    pums <- fread(paste0(inpath, 'PUMS', vintage, '_', mid, '.csv'))
    setkey(pums, SERIALNO, SPORDER)

    xp <- fread(paste0(outpath, 'weights_final_', reb, '_', mid, '_', yr, '.csv')) |>
      select(SERIALNO, SPORDER, new_WGTP) |> 
      left_join(pums, by=c('SERIALNO','SPORDER')) |> 
      setDT()
    fwrite(xp, paste0(outpath, 'reweighted_PUMS_', reb, '_', mid, '_', yr, '.csv'))
    rw <- xp[SPORDER == 1, lapply(.SD, sum), .(mpo), .SDcols = c('WGTP', 'new_WGTP')]
    rw[, rw_HH := round(new_WGTP)][, pums_baseline_hh := round(WGTP)]
    setkey(rw, mpo)
    
    r1 <- xp[SPORDER == 1, lapply(.SD, sum), .(mpo,AgeCat,HHtype), .SDcols = c('WGTP', 'new_WGTP')]
    r1[, new_WGTP := round(new_WGTP)][, WGTP := round(WGTP)]
    r1[,AgeCat:=paste0('x == ',AgeCat)]
    r1[,HHtype:=paste0('x == ',HHtype)]
    setkey(r1, mpo,AgeCat,HHtype)
    
    # Summarize total households by mpo from target inputs to reweighter
    target <- fread(paste0(input_path, 'hhtype.targetfile.', reb, '.y', yr, '.csv')) |>
      filter(RPA == mid) |> rename(mpo=RPA) |> setDT()
    setkey(target,mpo,AgeCat,HHtype)
    
    cc <- r1[target]
    cc[,diff:=new_WGTP-TARGET]
    cc[,year:=yr]
    
    
    tsum <- target[, lapply(.SD, sum), mpo, .SDcols = 'TARGET']
    tsum[, TARGET := round(TARGET)][,year:=yr]
    #setnames(tsum, 'RPA', 'mpo')
    setkey(tsum, mpo)
    
    comp <- tsum[rw]
    comp.out <- comp[,.(year,mpo,pums_baseline_hh, TARGET,rw_HH)]
    comp.out[,diff:= TARGET - rw_HH]
    fwrite(comp.out,paste0(outpath,'reweighter_QC_', reb, '_', mid, '_', yr,'.csv'))
    comp.dt <- rbind(comp.dt,comp.out)
    c0 <- rbind(c0,cc)
  }
}

fwrite(comp.dt,paste0(output_path,'reweighter_QC_all_RPAs_all_years_', reb,'.csv'))
fwrite(c0,paste0(output_path,'reweighter_QC_all_RPAs_by_AgeCat_HHtype_all_years_', reb, '.csv'))

comp.dt[abs(diff)>1]

}
```

# 7 - Create summary tables of reweighted households

```{r}

for (yr in c(2025,2030,2035,2040,2045,2050)){
# for (yr in c(2020)){
  sw <- data.table()
  for (mid in mpos){
    inp <- paste0(output_path, mid, '/')
    dt <- fread(paste0(inp, 'reweighted_PUMS_', reb, '_', mid, '_', yr, '.csv'))
    dt[, year:=yr][,reb:=reb]

  }
 fwrite(sw,paste0(output_path,'/reweighted_PUMS_', reb, '_', yr, '.csv'))
 }
```

# 8 - Join with Shelter Households and Compare with SHoP control totals

```{r}

cpi <- fread(paste0(root,'cpi_deflators_by_year.csv'))
cpi.deflator2021 <- cpi[year==2013, index] / cpi[year==2021, index]

 shelter.pums <- fread(paste0(shelter.path, "cleaned.shelter.pums.sample_run.1.csv")) |>
    mutate(
      # Align SERIALNO variables
      SERIALNO = SERIALNO.adj,
      PUMA = as.numeric(PUMA),
      HINCP.adj = case_when(
        HINCP.adj < 0 ~ 0,
        .default = HINCP.adj
      ),
      HINCP2013 = round(as.numeric(HINCP.adj) * cpi.deflator2021, 0)
    ,
    hh_income_group =
      cut(
        HINCP2013,
        breaks = c(-Inf, 35000, 75000, 125000, 225000, Inf),
        labels = c("1", "2", "3", "4", "5")
      ),
    adult = case_when(
      child == 1 ~ 0,
      child == 0 ~ 1
    )
    ) |> 
    group_by(SERIALNO) |> 
  mutate(
    workers = sum(worker),
    persons = max(SPORDER),
    children = sum(child),
    adults = sum(adult)
  ) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  # Categorizing household sizes by number of persons (1) one person, (2) two persons, (3) three persons, (4) four or more persons
  mutate(
    HHSize = case_when(
      persons == 1 ~ 1,
      persons == 2 ~ 2,
      persons == 3 ~ 3,
      persons >= 4 ~ 4
    ),
    # Determine type of household (1) hh with children, (3) multiple adults no children, (5) single
    HHtype = case_when(
      children > 0 & persons > 1 ~ 1,
      children == 0 & persons > 1 ~ 3,
      persons == 1 ~ 5
    ),
    pid = paste0(SERIALNO,'_',SPORDER)
    ) |> 
   setDT()
  


  if (reb == 'MAPC97') {
```

# 9 - Weight adjustment to match SWHP Scenario 3 regional total households
```{r}


```
